text_block_list.text:
Sakura Chiyono O's eyes blazed like 
wildfire with her dream as she ran. Yaeno 
Muteki became convinced that she was truly 
destined to be her worthy rival.

Yaeno Muteki practiced on her own until 
nightfall. Witnessing her dedication, 
Sakura Chiyono O felt her own motivation 
surge even higher.

Maruzensky watched happily over her. 
Seeing Sakura Chiyono O shoulder the dream 
she had passed on, pushing herself 
alongside someone else...

However, Mr. C.B., who was standing beside 
her, looked at her profile with a lonely 
expression.

Sakura Chiyono O had yet to realize their 
true intentions. For now, she advanced her 
pieces toward the Satsuki Sho.
